1009.description: A stiff-leg deadlift with a band, hinging at the hips. It trains the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and place the band around your ankles.
Hold the band with both hands in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and slowly lower your upper body towards the ground.
As you lower, push your hips back and allow your knees to bend slightly.
Lower the band towards the ground, feeling a stretch in your hamstrings.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your upper body back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开站立，与肩同宽，将弹力带绕在脚踝上。
用双手将弹力带放在大腿前面，手掌朝向身体。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，铰接臀部，慢慢将上半身降低到地面。
当你降低时，将臀部向后推，并让膝盖稍微弯曲。
将弹力带降低至地面，感受腿筋的拉伸。
在底部暂停片刻，然后启动臀肌和腿筋，将上半身抬回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1073.description: Press yourself away from the straps. It works the chest.
instructions: Face away from the anchor and hold the handles at chest level.
Lean forward in a straight line.
Press your body away.
Squeeze the chest.
Return slowly.

1137.description: Lying down with your feet in the straps, you sit up to train the abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your feet in the straps and knees bent.
Place your hands by your head or across your chest.
Curl your torso up toward your knees.
Squeeze the abs at the top.
Lower back down slowly.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

1201.description: A burpee with dumbbells that finishes with an overhead press. It builds strength and endurance.
instructions: Start in a standing position with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand.
Lower your body into a squat position, placing the dumbbells on the ground in front of you.
Kick your feet back into a push-up position, keeping your body in a straight line.
Perform a push-up, bending your elbows and lowering your chest towards the ground.
Jump your feet back towards your hands, landing in a squat position.
Stand up explosively, lifting the dumbbells off the ground and bringing them to your shoulders.
Press the dumbbells overhead, fully extending your arms.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders and repeat the entire sequence for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 从站立位置开始，双脚分开与肩同宽，每只手各拿一个哑铃。
将身体降低至蹲姿，将哑铃放在您面前的地面上。
将双脚踢回到俯卧撑位置，保持身体呈一条直线。
进行俯卧撑，弯曲肘部并将胸部降低到地面。
将脚向后跳向双手，以蹲姿着地。
爆发性地站起来，将哑铃从地上举起，放到肩膀上。
将哑铃举过头顶，充分伸展手臂。
将哑铃放回到肩膀上，然后重复整个序列，达到所需的重复次数。

1265.description: A one-arm incline cable press. It trains the upper chest and shoulders.
instructions: Adjust the cable machine to a low pulley position.
Sit on an incline bench facing away from the cable machine.
Grasp the handle with one hand and bring it up to shoulder height.
Position your feet firmly on the ground and maintain a stable position.
Press the handle forward and upward, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 将拉索机调整至低滑轮位置。
坐在倾斜的长凳上，背对缆绳机。
用一只手抓住手柄并将其举至肩膀高度。
将双脚牢牢放在地面上并保持稳定的位置。
向前和向上按下手柄，充分伸展手臂。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手柄放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1329.description: A bent over dumbbell row where your palms rotate as you pull. It works the upper back, lats and biceps through a varied path.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing your body.
Engage your core and pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you pull the dumbbells up, rotate your palms so they face away from your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your palms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，正握。
臀部向前弯曲，保持背部挺直，膝盖稍微弯曲。
让你的手臂笔直下垂，手掌朝向身体。
收紧核心肌群，将哑铃拉向胸部，保持肘部靠近身体。
当你向上拉哑铃时，旋转手掌，使其背向身体。
在动作的最高点将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
慢慢地将哑铃放回起始位置，将手掌旋转回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1393.description: A one-leg calf raise lifting a smith machine bar from the floor. It works each calf on its own under a guided bar path.
instructions: Position yourself on the floor under the smith machine bar, facing away from the machine.
Place the balls of your feet on a raised surface, such as a weight plate or block.
Position the smith machine bar across your lower legs, just above your ankles.
Hold onto the bar with your hands for stability.
Raise your heels off the ground by extending your ankles, lifting your body up.
Pause at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己放在史密斯机杆下方的地板上，背对机器。
将脚掌放在凸起的表面上，例如举重板或杠铃块。
将史密斯机杆放在小腿上，就在脚踝上方。
用手握住横杆以保持稳定。
伸展脚踝，将脚后跟抬离地面，抬起身体。
在动作的最高点暂停，然后慢慢降低脚跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1457.description: A standing barbell overhead press with a wide grip, which shifts more work to the shoulders. Keep your ribs down and your core tight.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Lift the barbell to shoulder height, keeping your elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Press the barbell overhead, extending your arms fully.
Lower the barbell back to shoulder height and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，正手握杠铃，握距略宽于肩。
将杠铃举至肩膀高度，保持肘部稍微位于杠铃前方。
将杠铃推过头顶，充分伸展双臂。
将杠铃降低回肩部高度，然后重复所需的重复次数。

1521.description: A hang clean started from below the knees. It lengthens the pull for more power.
instructions: Hold the bar just below your knees with a flat back and your shoulders over the bar.
Brace your core and keep the bar close to your body.
Extend your hips and knees powerfully and shrug your shoulders.
Pull yourself under the bar and catch it on your front shoulders in a squat.
Stand tall to finish, then lower the bar with control.

1585.description: A lunge position stretch for the hips, thighs and hamstrings, often used by runners to loosen up.
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart.
Take a step forward with your right foot, keeping your left foot planted.
Bend your right knee and lower your body down, keeping your left leg straight.
Place your hands on your right thigh for support.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides and repeat.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与臀部同宽站立。
右脚向前迈出一步，保持左脚踩地。
弯曲右膝，降低身体，保持左腿伸直。
将双手放在右大腿上以获得支撑。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后换边重复。

1649.description: Alternating dumbbell curls with one leg lifted while sitting on an exercise ball. It trains the biceps and challenges balance.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Place an exercise ball behind you and position one foot on top of it, keeping your balance.
With your arms fully extended and elbows close to your sides, curl one dumbbell towards your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
Lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，双手各握一个哑铃，手掌朝前。
将健身球放在身后，并将一只脚放在上面，保持平衡。
双臂完全伸展，肘部靠近身体两侧，将一只哑铃向肩膀弯曲，同时保持上臂静止。
将哑铃放回起始位置，然后用另一只手臂重复该动作。
继续交替手臂进行所需的重复次数。

1713.description: A partner-assisted stretch lying face down for the quads. It lengthens the front of the thigh.
instructions: Lie face down on the ground with your legs extended.
Bend your left knee and reach back with your left hand to grab your left foot or ankle.
Gently pull your left foot towards your glutes, feeling a stretch in your left quad.
Hold the stretch for 20-30 seconds, then release.
Repeat with your right leg.
instructionsZh: 脸朝下躺在地上，双腿伸直。
弯曲左膝，用左手向后抓住左脚或脚踝。
轻轻地将左脚拉向臀肌，感受左股四头肌的拉伸。
保持拉伸 20-30 秒，然后放松。
右腿重复上述动作。

1777.description: Reaching both arms overhead and back opens the front of your chest and shoulders. It is an easy stretch to undo hunched posture.
instructions: Stand tall and interlace your fingers, then raise your arms overhead.
Press your arms slightly back and lift your chest without arching your lower back.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1841.description: Lets gravity help stretch the back of the neck while you lie on your back.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent.
Clasp your hands behind your head.
Gently lift your head and ease your chin toward your chest.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Lower your head back down slowly.

1905.description: Lie with your legs resting on a wall and let them fall open to stretch the inner thighs.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hips close to a wall.
Rest your legs straight up the wall.
Let your legs fall slowly out to the sides.
Relax and let gravity do the work.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing slowly.
Bring your legs together to finish.

1969.description: A gentle rocking stretch that improves ankle movement and loosens the calf.
instructions: Stand facing a wall with one foot forward, toes a few inches from it.
Keep your front heel on the floor.
Bend the front knee and glide it toward the wall.
Return and repeat slowly for 10-15 reps, then switch feet.

2097.description: Spreads the fingers wide apart to open up the hand and loosen the small muscles between the fingers.
instructions: Hold one hand up in front of you with the palm facing you.
Spread your fingers as far apart as feels comfortable.
If you want more stretch, press between the fingers with your other hand.
Keep the wrist straight and the shoulder relaxed.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax the hand and switch sides.

2161.description: A standing or all fours kickback with a band that targets the glutes one leg at a time.
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it and loop it around one foot.
Stand holding a support, or get on all fours, with your core braced.
Kick one leg back against the band, keeping the knee straight.
Squeeze your glute and avoid arching your lower back.
Return slowly, finish your reps, then switch legs.

2289.description: A machine calf press pushing the pad with your toes. Builds the calf muscles.
instructions: Adjust the seat of the leverage machine so that your shoulders are aligned with the lever pad.
Place your toes on the lever pad, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or side supports for stability.
Push the lever pad down by extending your ankles, contracting your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by allowing your heels to rise back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 调整杠杆机的座椅，使肩膀与杠杆垫对齐。
将脚趾放在杠杆垫上，脚跟悬在边缘上。
抓住手柄或侧面支撑以保持稳定性。
伸展脚踝，收缩小腿肌肉，将杠杆垫向下推。
在动作的底部停顿片刻。
让脚后跟重新抬起，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

2353.description: A side-by-side form check for arm position during a concentration curl, showing the common mistake next to the correct technique so you can spot it in your own sets.
instructions: Sit on a bench, lean forward and brace your elbow against your inner thigh.
Compare the faulty version with the correct one: your upper arm rests against the inner thigh and only the forearm moves.
Perform the lift slowly with a light load and keep the correct position throughout.
Use a mirror or film a set from the side to check your own position.
Fix the cue before adding weight, and rest between sets so form stays clean.

2417.description: A low squat walk with a band around the legs that fires up the glutes and hips.
instructions: Place a loop band around your thighs or knees.
Lower into a half squat with your chest up.
Step sideways or forward with a wide stride.
Keep tension on the band and your knees out.
Bring your other foot in, staying low.
Walk for the planned distance, then return.

2737.description: A standing kickback with a straight leg that targets the glutes.
instructions: Stand tall and hold a support for balance.
Keep your standing knee slightly soft.
Lift one straight leg back behind you without arching your lower back.
Squeeze the glute at the top.
Lower with control and switch legs after your reps.

2801.description: A lying leg raise with a hip twist. Works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and your arms by your sides.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, bringing them towards your chest.
As you lift your legs, twist your hips to one side, bringing your knees towards your opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time twisting your hips to the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸展，双臂放在身体两侧。
弯曲膝盖，将双腿抬离地面，将它们拉向胸部。
当你抬起双腿时，将臀部扭向一侧，将膝盖移向另一侧的肩膀。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复这个动作，这次将臀部扭到另一侧。
继续交替进行所需的重复次数。

2929.description: Making waves with heavy ropes while kneeling. It raises your heart rate and burns the shoulders and arms.
instructions: Kneel in front of the anchored ropes and hold an end in each hand.
Brace your abs and keep your chest up.
Raise and lower your arms alternately to create waves.
Keep the waves quick and steady.
Work for a set time, then rest.

2993.description: A goblet squat held low with a kettlebell as a counterweight, used to loosen the hips and ankles.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns against your chest.
Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes slightly out.
Squat down as deep as you comfortably can with your chest up.
Use your elbows to push your knees out and pause at the bottom.
Rock gently side to side to open the hips.
Drive through your feet to stand back up.

3121.description: A seated row with a band and a straight back that trains the lats and mid back.
instructions: Sit on the floor with legs extended and a band around your feet.
Hold the ends with your arms straight.
Sit tall with a flat back.
Pull the band toward your waist, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

3185.description: A bench press with bands hanging weights from the bar. The shaky load trains control and stability.
instructions: Hang weights from each end of the bar with bands.
Lie on the bench and unrack the bar.
Hold it over your chest.
Lower the bar slowly to your mid chest.
Press up and keep the bar steady.
Use a lighter load than a normal bench press.

3249.description: A wider standing toe touch that reaches down with both hands to warm up the legs and back.
instructions: Stand with feet wide apart.
Hinge forward with both arms reaching down.
Touch the floor or your toes.
Rise slowly.
Repeat for the set.

3313.description: A weighted dip on a straight bar or parallel bars. It builds the chest, triceps and shoulders with added resistance.
instructions: Position yourself between parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将自己置于双杠之间，双臂完全伸展，身体伸直。
弯曲肘部降低身体，直到上臂与地面平行。
暂停片刻，然后伸直手臂，将自己推回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3377.description: A seated twist where you swing the ropes side to side. It trains the obliques and conditioning.
instructions: Sit on the floor with knees bent and lean back slightly.
Hold the rope ends in front of you.
Twist your torso to one side and swing the ropes.
Twist to the other side.
Keep your chest lifted and continue for the set time.

3441.description: A seated neck mobility drill moving the head forward and back.
instructions: Sit tall with your shoulders relaxed.
Lower your chin gently toward your chest.
Hold for a moment.
Slowly lift your head and look up slightly.
Move through a comfortable range only.
Repeat 8-10 times smoothly.

3505.description: A kneeling backbend that opens the chest, abs and front of the hips.
instructions: Kneel with knees hip-width apart and hands on your lower back.
Push your hips forward and lift your chest.
Lean back and reach for your heels if comfortable.
Let your head relax back gently.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, breathing evenly.
Come up slowly, leading with your chest.

3569.description: Pin a ball between your chest and a wall to release tight pectoral muscles.
instructions: Place a ball between your chest and a wall, just below the collarbone.
Lean in until you feel pressure on the chest muscle.
Roll slowly in small circles or up and down.
Hold on tender spots for a few breaths.
Switch sides after about 30-60 seconds.

3633.description: From a wide seated position, twist toward the left leg to stretch the inner thigh and torso.
instructions: Sit with legs spread wide and back tall.
Rotate your torso to the left.
Reach both hands toward your left foot.
Keep your hips grounded.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing steadily.
Release slowly and repeat on the other side if needed.

3697.description: A kneeling cable row with a rope that targets the rear delts. It trains the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Attach a rope handle to a low cable pulley and kneel down facing the machine.
Grasp the rope with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and extend your arms fully in front of you.
Keeping your back straight and core engaged, pull the rope towards your body by retracting your shoulder blades.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end of the movement and hold for a brief pause.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索手柄连接到低电缆滑轮上，面向机器跪下。
以中立握法（手掌相对）抓住绳子，并将双臂完全伸展到身前。
保持背部挺直，核心收紧，通过收缩肩胛骨将绳子拉向身体。
在动作结束时将肩胛骨挤压在一起并保持短暂的停顿。
慢慢释放张力并回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3761.description: Seated curls, alternating arms, to build the biceps.
instructions: Sit upright holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging.
Keep your elbows by your sides.
Curl one dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Lower slowly.
Alternate arms and avoid swinging.

3825.description: A lateral raise where you turn your palms over at the top. It works the side of your shoulders from two angles.
instructions: Stand with a light dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Raise your arms out to shoulder height with palms down.
Turn your palms up in mid air, then back down.
Lower the weights slowly.
Keep your elbows slightly bent.

3889.description: A sit-up with the legs in a frog position that works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Lie on your back with the soles of your feet together and knees falling out.
Place your hands behind your head or reach forward.
Curl up and sit all the way up.
Reach your hands toward your feet at the top.
Lower with control.
Avoid pulling on your neck.

4017.description: A standing one-arm spider curl bent forward. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Stand and hinge forward, bracing against a support.
Let one arm hang with a dumbbell.
Curl up.
Squeeze.
Lower and switch arms.

4081.description: Lying reverse crunch with a band for added resistance, focusing on the lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back with the band anchored overhead and held in your hands.
Bend your knees and lift your feet.
Curl your hips off the floor toward your chest.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly.

4145.description: A row with the hands close together against band tension. It works the mid back and lats with extra focus on the elbows staying tight to the body.
instructions: Anchor the band at chest height and hold both ends with hands close together.
Step back until the band is taut and stand tall with soft knees.
Row your hands toward your lower ribs, elbows brushing your sides.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the end.
Extend your arms slowly back to the start.
Keep your shoulders down and avoid leaning back.

4209.description: Push off with one leg to land on a box with both feet. It trains explosive single-leg power and a stable landing.
instructions: Stand facing a sturdy box on one leg.
Drive your arms up and push off explosively from that leg.
Land softly on the box with both feet at once.
Stand fully upright before stepping down.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

4401.description: A step-up finished with a knee drive, training the glutes and legs along with balance and hip flexor control.
instructions: Rest a barbell on your upper back and stand facing a box.
Place one foot on the box and press up through that heel.
Drive the other knee up toward your hip at the top.
Lower the knee and step back down under control.
Complete your reps, then switch legs.

4465.description: Self-massage with a small ball to ease tension in the calf. A simple way to loosen tight spots before or after training.
instructions: Place the ball under your calf while seated with your leg extended.
Shift your weight onto the ball until you feel moderate, tolerable pressure.
Roll slowly back and forth over a short range, about 2-3 cm at a time.
When you find a tender spot, pause on it and breathe for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your breathing steady and avoid rolling over bone or joints.
Repeat on the other side if needed.

4593.description: A rising rear-hand punch thrown to a partner's pad, driven by the legs and hips.
instructions: Face your partner, who holds a pad low in front of them.
Stand in a boxing stance and bend your knees slightly.
Drive up through your legs and rotate your hips.
Bring your right fist up in a tight arc to the pad.
Keep your left hand guarding.
Reset your stance.

4721.description: A standard bar curl for building the biceps with a steady, controlled lift.
instructions: Stand holding a bar with an underhand shoulder-width grip.
Keep your elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar up to shoulder height.
Squeeze your biceps.
Lower slowly without swinging.

4785.description: A pull-up from a seated position with your legs assisting. It builds lats and arms while reducing the load.
instructions: Sit under a bar and grab it with an overhand grip.
Extend your legs in front of you.
Pull your chest up toward the bar.
Squeeze your back at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

4849.description: A glute-ham raise with a band assisting the movement. It strengthens the hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Set up on a glute-ham bench or anchor your feet with a band assisting you.
Start with your torso down and hips locked.
Curl up using your hamstrings.
Squeeze your glutes at the top.
Lower with control.

4913.description: A partial pull-up with a narrow grip, done in the top half of the range. It focuses on the upper phase of the pull.
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with a narrow grip and pull up to the top position.
Lower yourself to about halfway.
Pull back up until your chin clears the bar.
Keep your chest up and your elbows close.
Avoid swinging.
Repeat for your reps.

4977.description: A superman variation with your feet in rings, lifting opposite arm and leg in turn. It builds the lower back and core.
instructions: Put your feet in the rings and get into a face-down plank.
Brace your core and keep your hips level.
Lift one arm forward while holding steady.
Return it and switch to the other arm.
Avoid letting your lower back sag.
Alternate sides for the full set.

5041.description: Lying face down, arms out to the sides in a T and lifted. It trains the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with arms straight out to the sides, thumbs up.
Keep your neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by squeezing your shoulder blades.
Hold briefly.
Lower slowly.

5105.description: A jumping jack where your arms and legs cross over each other at the center. It raises your heart rate and warms up the whole body.
instructions: Stand with your feet together and arms by your sides.
Jump your feet apart while raising your arms overhead.
Jump again, crossing your legs and your arms in front of you.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Keep a steady rhythm and continue for 30-60 seconds.

5169.description: Standing leg swings across the body to work the inner thigh. A simple move for the adductors.
instructions: Stand tall next to a wall or chair and hold on for balance.
Lift the outer leg slightly off the floor.
Swing it across the front of your standing leg.
Return slowly to the start without leaning.
Finish your reps, then turn around and switch legs.

5233.description: Punching across the body from a low squat. It builds leg endurance and trunk rotation.
instructions: Stand in a wide stance and sink into a half squat.
Keep your fists up near your chin.
Punch one arm across your body, rotating your torso.
Pull it back and punch with the other arm.
Stay low and keep a quick, controlled rhythm.

5297.description: A kneeling curl with the arms propped on a bench and a cable. It isolates the biceps.
instructions: Kneel in front of a bench with a low cable beside you.
Rest your upper arms on the pad.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulders.
Squeeze your biceps at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

5553.description: Seated cable row set up to emphasise the lats with a pull toward the hips.
instructions: Sit at the cable row with feet on the platform and knees slightly bent.
Grab the handle and lean back slightly.
Pull your elbows down and back toward your hips.
Squeeze your lats, then extend slowly.
Keep your chest up.

5745.description: A squat followed by an explosive jump. Builds power and conditioning in the legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit into a squat with your chest up.
Explode upward and jump as high as you can.
Land softly on bent knees and go straight into the next squat.
Keep your knees tracking over your toes.

5873.description: Lie on a bench and lower an EZ bar toward your forehead, then press back up. It builds the triceps with minimal wrist strain.
instructions: Lie on a bench holding an EZ bar above your chest.
Keep your upper arms vertical.
Bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your arms back to the start.
Keep your elbows from flaring.

6001.description: A glute bridge held with the left leg extended straight. Builds one-sided glute strength and pelvic control.
instructions: Lie on your back with both knees bent.
Straighten your left leg in line with your torso.
Press through the right heel to lift your hips.
Hold for 20-30 seconds with your hips level.
Lower slowly.

6065.description: A one-arm triceps kickback holding a bottle. It isolates the back of the arm.
instructions: Hinge forward with a flat back, upper arm parallel to the floor, bottle in hand.
Keep your elbow tight at your side.
Straighten your arm behind you.
Squeeze your triceps.
Bend slowly, then switch arms.

6193.description: A side-to-side squat holding a kettlebell. It builds hip mobility and leg strength.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell at your chest and stand wide.
Shift your weight to one side.
Squat down with the other leg straight.
Keep the bent knee over your toes.
Push back to the center.
Alternate sides.

6513.description: A chest-supported lever row that lets you pull heavy while your lower back stays out of the way.
instructions: Lean your chest against the pad and grab the handles.
Keep your shoulders relaxed.
Pull the handles toward your body, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Lower slowly and repeat.

6705.description: Lying on your back, you swing the legs side to side like wipers. It strengthens the obliques and trunk control.
instructions: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down.
Lift your legs straight up over your hips.
Lower both legs to one side without touching the floor.
Bring them back up through the middle.
Lower to the other side and keep alternating.

6769.description: Lying on your back with a ball under the base of the skull. It releases the deep muscles at the back of the neck.
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and a small ball under the base of your skull.
Relax your head onto the ball.
Make small nods or turns to roll over the muscle.
Keep the pressure gentle.
Breathe slowly.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.

6833.description: A seated side raise using kettlebells. It isolates the side delts without leg drive.
instructions: Sit upright on a bench holding a kettlebell in each hand at your sides.
Keep a slight bend in your elbows.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.

6961.description: A pull-up with the hands at different heights or one hand doing more work. It gently trains one-arm pulling strength.
instructions: Hang from the bar with one hand higher or on a towel and the other lower.
Brace your core and pull your chest up.
Lead with the working arm and pull your chin toward the bar.
Lower yourself under control.
Switch the hand positions on the next set.

7217.description: A face-down raise with the arms out to form a T. It strengthens the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Lie face down with your arms out to the sides in a T.
Keep your forehead near the floor and neck neutral.
Lift your arms off the floor by pinching your shoulder blades.
Hold for a second at the top.
Lower with control.

7281.description: Standing band kickback that isolates the glutes.
instructions: Loop a band around your ankles or anchor it low and loop it on one foot.
Stand tall holding something for balance.
Kick the working leg straight back.
Squeeze your glute at the top without arching your back.
Return slowly, then switch legs.

7921.description: A seated biceps curl with a cable, working one arm at a time. It gives constant tension throughout the movement.
instructions: Sit facing a low cable and hold the handle with one hand.
Rest your elbow near your side.
Curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly and switch arms after your set.

8369.description: A seated overhead reach that stretches the chest and shoulders. It helps open up the upper body after desk time.
instructions: Sit tall on a chair or bench.
Interlace your fingers and straighten your arms.
Raise them overhead with palms facing up.
Lift your chest and reach slightly back.
Breathe normally and hold for 20 to 30 seconds.
Release slowly.

8433.description: A seated forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.
instructions: Sit near the front of a sturdy chair and extend one leg with the heel on the floor.
Keep your back long.
Hinge forward from the hips and reach toward your toes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Switch legs and repeat.

8881.description: You rotate the forearm so the palm turns down against cable resistance. It strengthens the pronator muscles of the forearm.
instructions: Sit beside a low cable and hold the handle with your forearm resting on your thigh.
Start with your palm facing up and your wrist neutral.
Rotate your forearm so the palm turns down.
Pause, then rotate back slowly against the cable.
Keep your elbow still and move only the forearm.
Complete your reps and switch arms.

9009.description: Lying face down over a ball, you lift your legs behind you to work the glutes and lower back.
instructions: Lie face down over the ball with your hands on the floor.
Let your legs hang down with your toes light on the floor.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both legs until they are in line with your body.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly without swinging.
Keep your hands planted and your core tight.

9969.description: A gentle floor move where you slide your heel toward your hips and back. It restores knee and hip bend with low strain.
instructions: Lie on your back with both legs straight.
Slowly slide one heel along the floor toward your buttocks.
Bend the knee as far as feels comfortable.
Pause for a second.
Slide the heel back out until the leg is straight.
Repeat for your reps, then switch legs.

10097.description: A squat holding a weight plate in front of your chest. The plate acts as a counterweight and helps keep your torso upright.
instructions: Hold a weight plate at your chest with both hands.
Stand with feet shoulder width apart.
Squat down until your thighs are parallel.
Keep your chest up and elbows in.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep the plate close to your body.

10673.description: A squat holding a kettlebell at your chest. The weight in front helps you stay upright and use your legs.
instructions: Hold a kettlebell by the horns at your chest.
Stand with feet shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your chest tall.
Lower until your thighs are parallel or lower.
Push through your heels to stand.
Keep your elbows close to your body.

10865.description: A single-leg Romanian deadlift with the rear foot on a bench. It targets hamstrings and glutes.
instructions: Hold dumbbells with your rear foot resting on a bench.
Keep your front knee soft.
Hinge forward at the hips.
Lower the weights along your leg.
Squeeze your glutes to stand up.
Switch legs after the set.

10929.description: A towel slide that rotates the shoulder inward. It works the rotator cuff gently.
instructions: Stand side-on to a wall with a towel under your forearm.
Bend your elbow to 90 degrees against your side.
Slide your hand across your body along the wall.
Return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

11057.description: A seated cable move that trains your shoulder blades to pull back. It helps posture and builds the mid back.
instructions: Sit at a low cable station, feet braced, and hold the handle with straight arms.
Sit tall and let your shoulder blades stretch forward.
Pull your shoulder blades together, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the squeeze briefly.
Return slowly to the start.

11569.description: Standing, you lift one leg out to the side against band tension, working the outer hips.
instructions: Loop the band around your ankles or above the knees and stand tall.
Hold onto something for balance if needed.
Lift one leg out to the side with a straight knee.
Pause at the top without leaning.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps and switch legs.

0049.description: Chest supported on an incline bench, you row the bar toward your chest. Works the upper back with little lower back stress.
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的上斜凳。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部靠在垫子上，双脚平放在地上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持背部挺直，核心肌群参与。
将杠铃拉向胸部，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0113.description: A standing wide-grip curl. Emphasises the inner biceps.
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell with an overhand grip, hands wider than shoulder-width apart.
Let the barbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palms facing away from your body.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell upward by contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 站直，双脚分开与肩同宽，正手握住杠铃，双手分开比肩宽。
让杠铃悬挂在大腿前面，与手掌保持一臂距离，手掌背向身体。
保持上臂静止，呼气并通过收缩二头肌向上弯曲杠铃。
继续举起杠铃，直到二头肌完全收缩并且杠铃与肩部齐平。
挤压二头肌时，保持收缩位置短暂停顿。
吸气并慢慢开始将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0177.description: A high-pulley rope pulldown that sweeps the hands down to your sides. It works the lats and the muscles between the shoulder blades.
instructions: Attach a rope attachment to the cable machine at a high position.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with an overhand grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly back.
Pull the rope down towards your sides, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement.
Slowly release the tension and allow the rope to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将绳索附件连接到电缆机的高位置。
面向机器站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
正手握住绳子，手掌相对。
保持背部挺直并稍微向后倾斜。
将绳子向下拉向身体两侧，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在动作的底部停顿片刻。
慢慢释放张力，让绳子回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0241.description: A triceps pushdown with a v-bar on a high pulley. The angled grip lets you press hard and squeeze the triceps.
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with an overhand grip, palms facing down, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在最高设置下将 V 形杆附件连接到电缆机上。
面对电缆机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
正手握住 V 形杆，手掌朝下，双手与肩同宽。
在整个练习过程中，保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
收紧三头肌并呼气，同时向下推 V 形杆，直到手臂完全伸展。
在动作的底部暂停片刻，挤压你的三头肌。
吸气，同时缓慢地将 V 形杆返回到起始位置，保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数。

0305.description: A face-down dumbbell shrug on a decline bench. You raise the shoulders toward the ears to work the traps.
instructions: Set up a decline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 设置一个 45 度角的下斜凳。
脸朝下躺在长凳上，胸部和腹部靠在长凳上。
每只手握住一个哑铃，双臂完全伸向地板。
保持手臂伸直，将肩膀尽可能高地抬向耳朵。
保持收缩一会儿，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0369.description: Forearms rest over a bench with palms up, and you curl the dumbbells with your wrists. A direct move for forearm size and grip.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your forearms resting on the bench and your palms facing up, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Allow your wrists to hang over the edge of the bench.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，前臂放在长凳上，手掌朝上，每只手各握一个哑铃。
让手腕悬在长凳边缘。
慢慢向上弯曲手腕，在动作的最高点挤压前臂。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢将手腕放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0433.description: Lying on a bench, you move a dumbbell in an arc over your head with straight arms and bring it back over your chest. It works the chest and lats.
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet planted firmly on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc-like motion.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺在长凳上，头朝一端，双脚牢牢踩在地上。
双手握住哑铃，将手臂伸直至胸部上方。
保持手臂伸直，以弧线动作慢慢将哑铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将哑铃举回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0497.description: Hanging beneath a bar, you pull your chest up with a straight body. This version changes the grip or angle. It builds the upper back and biceps.
instructions: Set up a bar at waist height on a Smith machine or use a suspension trainer.
Stand facing the bar or suspension trainer and grab it with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Walk your feet forward, leaning back until your body is at a slight angle.
Keep your body straight and pull your chest up towards the bar or handles, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 在史密斯机上在腰部高度设置一根杠铃或使用悬挂训练器。
面向杠铃或悬吊训练器站立，用正手握法抓住它，双手与肩同宽。
双脚向前走，向后倾斜，直到身体呈轻微角度。
保持身体挺直，将胸部向上拉向杠铃或手柄，将肩胛骨挤压在一起。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢降低回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0561.description: Kneeling on the floor, you press your palms down to stretch the underside of the forearms. Useful for lifters with tight wrists.
instructions: Kneel on the floor and place your palms down with fingers pointing toward your knees.
Keep your palms flat and arms straight.
Slowly sit your hips back to increase the stretch.
Stop when you feel a pull along the inner forearms.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Ease off gently and shake out your hands.

0625.description: A sit-up that includes a ball throw to a wall. It builds the abs with an explosive finish.
instructions: Sit on the floor facing a wall, knees bent, holding a medicine ball.
Lean back and lower your back to the floor.
Sit up and throw the ball at the wall.
Catch it on the rebound.
Lower back down with control.
Repeat for reps.

0689.description: Seated on a bench, you lift your legs and lower them again. Works the lower abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on a flat bench with your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands on the sides of the bench for support.
Keeping your legs straight, slowly raise them up in front of you until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在平坦的长凳上，背部挺直，双脚平放在地面上。
将双手放在长凳两侧以获得支撑。
保持双腿伸直，慢慢将它们抬起到您面前，直到它们与地面平行。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0753.description: On a decline bench, you press a smith machine bar from your lower chest. Works the lower chest and triceps.
instructions: Adjust the decline bench to the desired angle.
Lie down on the bench with your feet secured under the foot pads.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Unrack the barbell and lower it slowly towards your chest, keeping your elbows tucked in.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将下斜凳调整至所需角度。
躺在长凳上，双脚固定在脚垫下。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
松开杠铃，慢慢将其降低到胸部，保持肘部内收。
在底部停顿片刻，然后将杠铃推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0817.description: An overhead stretch for the back of the upper arm, pulling the elbow toward the head. It loosens the triceps and shoulders.
instructions: Stand or sit upright with your back straight.
Extend one arm overhead, bending it at the elbow.
Place your opposite hand on the bent elbow and gently pull it towards your head.
Hold the stretch for 15-30 seconds, feeling a gentle stretch in your triceps.
Release the stretch and repeat on the other arm.
instructionsZh: 站立或坐直，背部挺直。
将一只手臂伸过头顶，肘部弯曲。
将另一只手放在弯曲的肘部上，然后轻轻地将其拉向头部。
保持拉伸 15-30 秒，感受三头肌的轻微拉伸。
松开拉伸并在另一只手臂上重复。

0881.description: A lunge where you step back and across behind you, like a curtsey. It works the glutes and outer hips from a different angle.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Step one leg back and across behind the other.
Bend both knees and lower until your front thigh is near parallel.
Keep your chest up and hips square.
Push through your front foot to return to standing.
Repeat on the other side and alternate.

0945.description: Fold forward over your knees with arms extended on the floor. A restful stretch for the back, hips and shoulders.
instructions: Kneel on the floor with big toes touching and knees apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels.
Fold forward and slide your arms out in front of you.
Rest your forehead on the floor and relax your shoulders.
Hold for 20-30 seconds while breathing slowly.
